title: Deep learning six-type classifier for lung cancer and mimics on whole slide images
summary: EfficientNet-B5 and ResNet-50 models were developed on 741 whole slide images and compared, with EfficientNet-B5 chosen for a six-type classifier of lung adenocarcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma, small cell carcinoma, tuberculosis, organizing pneumonia and normal lung. Across four test cohorts (1067 slides) AUCs were 0.970, 0.918, 0.963 and 0.978, and agreement with pathologists exceeded an ICC of 0.873. The study is retrospective.
ai_technology: EfficientNet-B5 deep learning classifier with a threshold-based tumour-first aggregation
organization: Sun Yat-sen University (Zhongshan School of Medicine)

evidence.tested: Multi-centre testing on slides from SYSUFH, Shenzhen People's Hospital and TCGA, with blinded review by four pathologists.
evidence.unknown: Prospective and workflow performance; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Classifies whole slide images into six lung tissue or disease types.
